reviews.title: Deceiving Trail period-not a great fit for a more mature/advanced Stoner
reviews.text:
I assumed the 1 week free trial was for 7 days. Upon contacting Customer service, it was explained to me that 3 days in, that I was unable to reverse their charges and Paid in advance for annual yearly membership. 
It’s possible that I felt duped, but following that conversation, I then found the daily checks ins and material covered has an underlying religious vibe which is not my cup of tea. Initially I appreciated the concept of taking a break, Not quitting completely. But, the topics were more towards the commitment to never utilize cannabis again. 
This app seems to focus on a younger generation, but may have potential to inspire others to use marijuana safely and in a way that benefits them.

reviews.title: Helpful Information BUT…
reviews.text: The check-in notifications are a mixed bag of corny and triggering. To see an alarming alert pop up on my Apple Watch saying I owe the IRS absolutely set my adrenaline sky high. Shame on you.

reviews.title: Close to great
reviews.text:
At its core. This is a great app, and a very helpful program, however, there are two things that seem like core design flaws that inhibit its ability to maximize efficacy. 
1. Journal seemingly have to be posted of the community, and I want none of that. I’d love to be able to keep a journal of my thoughts so I could reflect on them and have them be analyzed by focused AI, but I absolutely don’t wanna share anything with randos. 
2. The app is designed to reveal a little at a time, but buries the lede: there’s a Life Program that aids moderation, vs going cold turkey, and I wish I knew that before undergoing a week of brutal withdrawal. I’d like to ease off before a hard break, and I can’t be alone.

reviews.text: Was always skeptical about apps like these, especially since I’ve been smoking weed for like 25 years straight. I have found that when I tried to stop before these apps are mostly just money grabs or secret religious groups trying to bring me to God, which doesn’t work because I don’t believe in one. This app was really refreshing. I worked with me on my goals and wasn’t preachy. Didn’t ask me if I wanted to stop forever. reviews.title: Scammy Billing
reviews.text:
I downloaded this to check it out and try it out. I signed up for 3 day free trial and had to give my cc info. I signed up using a phone number. 
I then deleted the app after one day as it was not what I was looking for and I found a better app to meet my needs. I didn’t think anything of the trial and billing because I never got a confirmation or receipt or email or anything on how to manage. So imagine my surprise when they billed me $40 today and there is literally no way for me to sign in and cancel. The app says I have no account using the phone or email that I have…so how can they charge me $40 when I cannot even log in and don’t have an account?? This appears to be a stoners scam…

reviews.title: It worked for me
reviews.text: I’ve taken a lot of T breaks and this was the easiest one I’ve ever done. 30 days sounds like a lot but an app honestly helped so much to keep me accountable and focused on my goal. Daily check-ins, and little lessons that made me think about my weed use and reflect on what I want out of it. It seems stupid to use an app especially one you gotta pay for to have the full experience of 30 days, but it actually worked for me! I went from smoking every single day and it being the highlight of everyday to going days without even thinking about weed at all. It sounds insane but I really recommend trying this

reviews.title: Not effective

I’ve since quit that habit completely on my own without the help of this app. If you are reading this and want to stop but are to scared to take the first step, my advice to you is just do it and commit. Stop lying to yourself stop being an enemy to your own mind. It will get better with time you just need patience and commitment.

reviews.title: Ok app if it was free, not enough to pay for
reviews.text: This app has some good tips if you stay engaged with it. The idea of using it to connect with others is nice though I seems like users all fit in a similar category. It has some major flaws. It constantly pops up notifications with the word “weed” in them. If you are in a professional setting or want to be discreet, that’s doesn’t work. The breadth of the target audience seems too specific. Most testimonials and video tips are done by young males. If you’re not in that category, it doesn’t feel like it’s made for you. It tracks your (lack of) smoking for 30 days, not beyond. Bummer if your goal is anything else. Once you get to 30 days, it asks you to answer a few questions to get a breakdown of the goals you met. If you don’t agree to film a testimony, you can’t seem to get past that part. Overall, I’d say it was helpful for the first few days to week of using it, then repetitive.
